gotchas: Guest booking, no login needed. Cheapest test basket: NYP -> PHL Coach Value fare ($10 on 2026-10-22).

The fare finder's date input is covered by its floating <label>, so a fill or click on it times out; focus it and send keypresses, then Enter. FIND TRAINS stays aria-disabled until both stations and the date are set; press Enter on it.
Radios (points opt-out, travel protection) are visually hidden inputs covered by styled divs: press Space on them instead of clicking.
Traveler Details requires a date of birth (input[autocomplete=bday], MM/DD/YYYY) and a mobile number (country code combobox defaults to US).

Payment page: a 'Add Travel Protection' radiogroup must be answered and Confirmed before the card form is usable. Card form is CyberSource Flex Microform: card number and security code are two separate iframes from flex.cybersource.com (number first, code second); expiry is a plain page input 'mm yy' (input[autocomplete=cc-exp]), and billing first/last name, address, city, state, ZIP and country are plain page fields. 'Add Credit Card' then 'Purchase' are the final buttons.
The order total is shown as a level-3 heading '$10.00' in the Price Summary; no stable selector for an order.total hint was found.
A reCAPTCHA Enterprise frame is present on the payment page (invisible); it did not challenge during the fill.

route.note: Fare finder: pick From and To stations from the combobox suggestions; type MM/DD/YYYY into input[data-julie=departdisplay_booking_oneway] by keypresses, then Enter; press Enter on button[data-julie=findtrains]. Coach from $ -> Value fare -> SELECT; Trip Summary Continue; Traveler Details (names, mobile, email, date of birth, No to points) Continue; on Payment answer 'No, do not protect my trip' and Confirm.
